title: Present someone you know
goal: Present a family member or friend: name, age, nationality, city, work or studies, appearance and personality.

items.en: Let me introduce my sister. (to a friend, tu)
Let me introduce my husband. (formal, or to several people)
here is, this is (presenting someone or something)

items.note: Same word for a man or a woman: un collègue, une collègue.
Here it's ma, not mon: meilleure starts with a consonant.
Same form for masculine and feminine.

example.fr: Mon fils est étudiant à Toronto.
example.en: My son is a student in Toronto.

items.note: Feminine: étudiante. After être, no article: il est étudiant.

blocks.title: Mei writes about her best friend
blocks.fr:
Je vous présente ma meilleure amie, Sofia. Elle est mexicaine et elle a trente-quatre ans. Elle habite à Montréal avec son mari, Alex, et ses deux enfants.
Sofia est infirmière. Elle travaille à l'hôpital. Elle parle espagnol, anglais et français.
Elle est petite et brune, et elle a les yeux noirs. Elle est très drôle et très gentille. C'est une super amie !
blocks.en:
Let me introduce my best friend, Sofia. She's Mexican and she's thirty-four. She lives in Montréal with her husband, Alex, and her two children.
Sofia is a nurse. She works at the hospital. She speaks Spanish, English and French.
She's short and dark-haired, and she has dark eyes. She's very funny and very kind. She's a great friend!

blocks.title: Amira introduces a colleague
blocks.context: At a welcome lunch for new employees in Montréal, Amira presents her colleague.
blocks.fr: Bonjour à tous ! Voici mon collègue, Olivier. Il est français, et il habite à Montréal. Il a quarante ans. Il est marié et il a trois enfants. Il est grand et blond, et il a les yeux bleus. Il est un peu sérieux, mais il est très sympa !
blocks.en: Hello everyone! This is my colleague, Olivier. He's French, and he lives in Montréal. He's forty. He's married and he has three children. He's tall and blond, and he has blue eyes. He's a bit serious, but he's really nice!

blocks.body: This lesson brings the whole unit together, plus units 1 to 3. Read and listen first: you know almost every word. [[infirmière]] = nurse, [[l'hôpital]] = the hospital.

blocks.title: Starting
blocks.body:
Choose the opening that fits the situation:

- [[Je te présente…]] to one friend: *This is… / Meet…*
- [[Je vous présente…]] formal, or to a group
- [[Voici…]] neutral: *Here is… / This is…*
- [[C'est…]] the simplest, perfect with a photo

Then give the name: [[Il s'appelle Karim.]] / [[Elle s'appelle Lucie.]] (same verb as [[je m'appelle]]).

blocks.title: Your toolkit from units 1–4
head: To say…
Use
Example
rows: être + adjective, avoir les cheveux / les yeux
Elle est grande. Elle a les cheveux longs.
blocks.note: Jobs work like nationalities: no article after être. [[Il est étudiant.]] [[Elle est infirmière.]] You'll learn many more jobs in a later unit.

blocks.title: Linking your sentences
blocks.pattern: et · mais · aussi · très · un peu
blocks.note: Short sentences are fine at A1. Two or three links make them sound natural.

examples.fr: Il est grand et il a les yeux bleus.
examples.en: He's tall and he has blue eyes.

examples.fr: Elle est timide, mais elle est très drôle.
examples.en: She's shy, but she's very funny.

examples.fr: Il parle anglais et français aussi.
examples.en: He speaks English and French too.

blocks.title: Unit 4 checklist
blocks.body:
Before you speak or write, check these five points:

- **son / sa / ses** follow the noun: Sofia et [[son mari]], Raj et [[sa femme]].
- **Agreement:** a woman is [[grande]], [[gentille]], [[sérieuse]], [[mariée]], [[canadienne]].
- **être or avoir:** [[Il a quarante ans]], [[Il a les yeux bleus]], but [[Il est grand]].
- **Articles:** [[un ami]], [[une personne]], [[le mari de Sofia]]; no article after être + nationality or job.
- **Best friend:** [[mon meilleur ami]], [[ma meilleure amie]] (ma, because meilleure starts with a consonant).

blocks.title: Tu or vous when you introduce someone?
blocks.body:
In Québec workplaces, colleagues often switch to *tu* quickly, so [[Je te présente…]] is very common between co-workers. Use [[Je vous présente…]] with a group, a client, an older person or anyone you call *vous*. When in doubt, [[Voici…]] works everywhere.

On forms, you will see [[célibataire]] (single), [[marié(e)]] (married) and [[conjoint(e) de fait]] (common-law partner).

blocks.title: Exam tip: TEF / TCF Canada
blocks.body: Speaking tests such as the TCF Canada begin with simple questions about you, your life and the people around you. A strong A1 answer is **6–8 short, correct sentences** covering different information (name, age, city, family, personality), with [[et]], [[mais]] and [[aussi]] to link them. Accuracy on être/avoir and agreement makes a big difference.

blocks.title: Listen and repeat
blocks.note: These are the building blocks of your mission.

lines.fr: Je te présente ma meilleure amie, Sofia.
lines.en: This is my best friend, Sofia.

lines.fr: Elle s'appelle Lucie. Elle a trente ans.
lines.en: Her name is Lucie. She's thirty.
lines.tip: The t of trente links to ans: “tran-tan”.
Liaison: est‿étudiant, the t is heard.

lines.fr: Elle est grande et elle a les yeux verts.
lines.en: She's tall and she has green eyes.

lines.fr: Il est un peu timide, mais très gentil.
lines.en: He's a bit shy, but very kind.

steps.title: Checkpoint: units 1 to 4
steps.intro: This checkpoint mixes everything since unit 1. Answer without scrolling back.

blocks.prompt: Lucie introduces you to her grandmother. What do you say?
blocks.explain: With an older person you've just met, be polite: Bonjour + madame, and vous if you continue.
optionFeedback: Salut is for friends; too casual here.
Toi is for friends; too casual here.

blocks.text: Mon collègue ___ quarante ans et il ___ indien.
blocks.en: My colleague is forty and he's Indian.

blocks.prompt: This is my neighbour, Camille (a woman). She lives in Gatineau.
accept: C'est ma voisine, Camille. Elle habite à Gatineau.
Voici ma voisine, Camille. Elle habite à Gatineau.
Je te présente ma voisine, Camille. Elle habite à Gatineau.
Je vous présente ma voisine, Camille. Elle habite à Gatineau.
C'est ma voisine Camille. Elle habite à Gatineau.
Voici ma voisine Camille. Elle habite à Gatineau.
Je te présente ma voisine Camille. Elle habite à Gatineau.
Je vous présente ma voisine Camille. Elle habite à Gatineau.
blocks.explain: voisine is feminine → ma; habiter à + city.

blocks.text: Ma meilleure amie est ___ et très ___. (canadien / sympa)
blocks.en: My best friend is Canadian and very nice.
blocks.explain: canadien → canadienne for a woman; sympa doesn't change in the feminine.

blocks.prompt: Her husband speaks French and English.
accept: Son mari parle français et anglais
Son mari parle anglais et français
blocks.explain: mari is masculine → son (even for her husband). il → parle.

blocks.fr: Mon collègue s'appelle Raj. Il a trente-cinq ans.
accept: Mon collègue s'appelle Raj. Il a 35 ans.
blocks.explain: [[s'appelle]] has two l's; [[trente-cinq]] takes a hyphen.

optionFeedback: Eyes are something you have: avoir.
French uses les for hair and eyes, not ses.

blocks.prompt: My son is a student in Toronto.
accept: Mon fils est étudiant à Toronto.
blocks.explain: Like nationalities, jobs and studies take no article after être: il est étudiant.

blocks.prompt: Match. These come from units 1 to 4.

blocks.text: Lucie est ___ personne très gentille. ___ enfants de Lucie sont drôles.
blocks.en: Lucie is a very kind person. Lucie's children are funny.
blocks.explain: personne is feminine → une; specific children (Lucie's) → les.

steps.title: Mission: present someone you know
steps.intro: This is the unit mission. Choose a real person: a family member, a friend, a neighbour or a colleague.

blocks.prompt: You're at a community event. Present someone you know to a new friend. Talk for about 45 seconds: who the person is, their name, age, nationality, city, work or studies, appearance and personality.
checklist: An opening: Je te présente… / Voici… / C'est…
Personality, with très or un peu
At least two links: et, mais, aussi

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: Je te présente mon voisin, Nguyen. Il est vietnamien et il a cinquante-deux ans. Il habite à Moncton avec sa femme, Hoa, et ses enfants. Il travaille à l'hôpital. Il parle vietnamien, anglais et un peu français. Il est petit et brun, et il a les yeux noirs. Il est un peu sérieux, mais il est très gentil et très drôle !
models.en: This is my neighbour, Nguyen. He's Vietnamese and he's fifty-two. He lives in Moncton with his wife, Hoa, and his children. He works at the hospital. He speaks Vietnamese, English and a little French. He's short and dark-haired, and he has dark eyes. He's a bit serious, but he's very kind and very funny!

blocks.prompt: Write a short text presenting someone important to you, for a class newsletter. Include at least six pieces of information.
blocks.promptFr: Présentez une personne importante pour vous.
checklist: Appearance: one être sentence and one avoir sentence
Personality: two adjectives with the right endings

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: Je vous présente mon frère, Karim. Il a trente-deux ans et il est marocain, comme moi. Il habite à Gatineau avec sa femme, Nadia, et ses deux enfants. Il travaille à Ottawa. Karim est grand et brun, et il a les yeux marron. Il est très drôle et très gentil. C'est aussi mon meilleur ami !
models.en: Let me introduce my brother, Karim. He's thirty-two and he's Moroccan, like me. He lives in Gatineau with his wife, Nadia, and his two children. He works in Ottawa. Karim is tall and dark-haired, and he has brown eyes. He's very funny and very kind. He's also my best friend!

models.label: Model answer (about a woman)
models.fr: Voici ma collègue, Camille. Elle est québécoise et elle a vingt-neuf ans. Elle habite à Montréal. Elle est célibataire. Elle est étudiante, et elle travaille aussi dans un café. Elle est petite et blonde, et elle a les cheveux courts. Elle est sérieuse, mais elle est aussi très sympa.
models.en: This is my colleague, Camille. She's from Québec and she's twenty-nine. She lives in Montréal. She's single. She's a student, and she also works in a café. She's short and blond, and she has short hair. She's serious, but she's also very nice.

summary:
- Introduce someone with [[Je te présente…]], [[Je vous présente…]], [[Voici…]] or [[C'est…]]
- Give their name, age, nationality, city, work or studies, and family situation
- Describe appearance with être **and** avoir, and personality with agreeing adjectives
- Link short sentences with [[et]], [[mais]], [[aussi]], [[très]] and [[un peu]]
